# Dependencies

This folder tracks dependencies that cross project boundaries.

## Files

- `active.md` - current cross-project dependencies, blockers, and dependency decisions
- `dependency-map.md` - high-level relationship map
- `by-project/` - per-project dependency views
- `archived/` - resolved or obsolete dependency records

## Notes

- Use project-level `dependencies.md` for dependencies local to one project.
- Update this folder when a dependency affects more than one project.
